description: Ask the Grid connects ChatGPT to live and historical US electricity-grid data. Check current grid conditions, find and query published market datasets, read Energy Wire briefings, explore grid assets, and manage your own alerts and saved grid assets. Results retain source, timestamp, market, and unit context.
